# Code points in the Cast Symbols subset: what the TUI draws that the site's
# IBM Plex Mono subset lacks. One point (U+XXXX) or range (U+XXXX..U+YYYY) per line.
# The web player draws box drawing and blocks (U+2500..U+259F) itself.
# A new TUI glyph is one line here plus a rerun of site/capture/cast-symbols.py.
